## Crescent Energy Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 15, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/856702509/files/doc_news/2026/10/Crescent-Energy-Schedules-Q3-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-10-15-26.pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Crescent Energy Company (NYSE: CRGY) today announced plans to host a conference call and webcast at 10 a.m. CT, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The Company plans to release results after market close on Monday, November 2, 2026. The earnings release, supplemental slides and live webcast will be available through the Investors section of the Company’s website at[www.crescentenergyco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrescentenergyco.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54622732&newsitemid=20261015623858&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crescentenergyco.com&index=1&md5=987c7f3259179b4234333decab4d862c) .


**Conference Call Information**


Time: 10 a.m. CT (11 a.m. ET)
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026
Conference Dial-In: 833-461-5787 / 585-542-9983 (Domestic / International)
Meeting ID: 360 772 191
Webcast Link:[www.crescentenergyco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrescentenergyco.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54622732&newsitemid=20261015623858&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crescentenergyco.com&index=2&md5=2614afbafb6d312f3ebe2ce750510d99)


A webcast replay will be available on the website following the call.


**About Crescent Energy**


Crescent is a differentiated energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with deep, high-quality development inventory. Our activities are focused in the Eagle Ford, Permian and Uinta Basins, and we own minerals and royalty interests across premier U.S. oil and natural gas basins, primarily operated by large, well-capitalized companies, with a core focus in the Eagle Ford. For additional information, please visit[www.crescentenergyco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrescentenergyco.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54622732&newsitemid=20261015623858&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crescentenergyco.com&index=3&md5=d8bc608ee136632d4ed98ccad5de69f5) .
